name: web
description: Search the live web and read pages, through a self-hosted SearXNG.
summary: Searches the live web and reads specific pages, through a self-hosted SearXNG. Use only for what TARDIS cannot already know: current events, prices, exchange rates, documentation, anything past the model's training cutoff. Never for the user's own data — spending, meals, notes, reminders and calendar live in other plugins and are always more accurate there. Every result carries the URL it came from, so answers can cite a source.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn web search and page reading on or off.

searxngUrl.label: SearXNG URL
searxngUrl.description: Base URL of the SearXNG instance to search through.

maxResults.label: Results per search
maxResults.description: Snippets are a token budget, not a page — five is usually plenty.

timeoutMs.label: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a search or a page before giving up.

skills.description: Search the web and get back titles, URLs and snippets. Use for facts that change or postdate your training — prices, rates, news, releases, documentation. Answer from the snippets and cite the URL you used. Do not use it for anything the user has told TARDIS themselves.

query.description: What to search for, phrased as a search query rather than a sentence

limit.description: How many results to return (1-10, default 5)

skills.description: Fetch one web page and summarise it. Use after web.search when a snippet is not enough, or when the user gives you a URL to read. Pass their question so the summary answers it rather than describing the page.

url.description: Full URL of the page to read

question.description: What to look for on the page. Omit for a general summary.
